_comment: ShellTerra OldTownActivities seed data. Times are San Diego local, 24h, no timezone suffix. One activity per line for review.
_source: oldtownsandiego.org community calendar + California State Parks ArcGIS events service, pulled 2026-09-07, window 2026-09-07..2026-12-31
_verify_before_running: Live shell is named 'OldtownActive' (id 6a8e62145a3f0ee11ec0), currently is_private:true / public_override:false. Set SHELL_ID=6a8e62145a3f0ee11ec0 before seeding, then run the public override.

Business-association venue coords are block-level approximations (Fiesta de Reyes, Harney St, Heritage Park, Event Check In). State Parks records (walking tours, junior ranger, story time, hidden history, community celebration) carry exact coords.

The 4 'Historic Walking Tour' rows use recurrence:weekly because State Parks publishes an occurrence count + range but NOT individual dates, and nothing past September. Weekly keeps a rolling live card per tour time. Replace with real dates (or daily pre-expansion) if the park publishes them.

Cross-feed dups already removed: Fiestas Patrias 2026-09-12, Dia de Los Muertos 2026-10-31 and 2026-11-01 are seeded once (from the oldtownsandiego.org pull). The 2026-11-02 'Community Celebration' + 'Procession' are distinct state-parks events, kept.

items.title: Dia de los Muertos - La Experiencia
items.description: A free, family-friendly immersive plaza experience with artful Catrinas, colorful skeletons, altars and marigolds, enhanced by new after-sunset lighting, running daily through November 2.

items.title: Reopening After Private Event
items.description: Fiesta de Reyes reopens to the public at 10:00 AM after being closed on October 7 for a private event.

items.title: Mariachi Divinas Live
items.description: Free live Mariachi Divinas performance on the Fiesta de Reyes stage (recurring Wednesdays and Thursdays).

items.title: Los Trinos Mariachi Fusion & Luis Max and Blue Moon Live
items.description: Free Saturday live entertainment with Los Trinos Mariachi Fusion (12:15 pm) followed by Luis Max & Blue Moon (5:00 pm) on the Fiesta de Reyes stage.

items.title: Folklorico Dancing & Los Trinos Mariachi Fusion Live
items.description: Free Sunday entertainment featuring folklorico dancing (11:30 am) and Los Trinos Mariachi Fusion (4:00 pm) on the Fiesta de Reyes stage.

items.title: Dia de los Muertos Celebration
items.description: Casa Guadalajara (with Bazaar del Mundo) honors departed loved ones with decorated altars, free sugar-skull/face-painting activities, and mariachi performances in skeleton face paint.

items.title: Dia de los Muertos Celebration
items.description: Second day of the Day of the Dead festivities at Casa Guadalajara and Bazaar del Mundo, including an Old Town Altar Walk with maps to view decorated altars throughout the neighborhood.

items.title: La Experiencia - Dia de los Muertos at Barra Barra
items.description: During Fiesta de Reyes' Dia de los Muertos 'La Experiencia' celebration (running through November 2, 2026), the plaza fills with Catrinas, marigolds, altars and glowing displays while Barra Barra serves candlelit house margaritas, tequila flights and dinner.

items.title: Thanksgiving Buffet
items.description: The Cosmopolitan Hotel & Restaurant hosts a traditional Thanksgiving holiday buffet in its historic Old Town setting.

items.title: Altar Tour
items.description: Specialized guided tour through park museums exploring the symbolism of Dia de los Muertos altars and the stories of families who lived in Old Town in the 1800s.
items.locationName: Old Town San Diego State Historic Park

items.title: Altar Tour
items.description: Specialized guided tour through park museums exploring the symbolism of Dia de los Muertos altars and the stories of families who lived in Old Town in the 1800s.
items.locationName: Old Town San Diego State Historic Park

items.title: Dia de los Muertos Celebration
items.description: Annual three-day Day of the Dead celebration (Oct 31 - Nov 2, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. daily) featuring community and historic altars, live entertainment, hands-on art, and cultural programming.
items.locationName: Old Town San Diego State Historic Park

items.title: La Catrina Contest (Children)
items.description: Children's Catrina costume competition at Plaza de Armas with music, dancing, and prizes for winners.
items.locationName: Old Town San Diego State Historic Park

items.title: La Catrina Contest (Adults)
items.description: Adults' Catrina costume competition at Plaza de Armas with music, dancing, and prizes for winners.
items.locationName: Old Town San Diego State Historic Park

items.title: Candlelit Procession
items.description: Annual candlelit procession from Twiggs Street to El Campo Santo Cemetery featuring Aztec dancers, park staff in 1800s period attire, and Catrina Contest winners.
items.locationName: Old Town San Diego State Historic Park

items.title: Summer Movies in the Park: Practical Magic
items.description: A free outdoor screening of the romantic fantasy film Practical Magic (PG-13), with pre-show activities at 5:30 PM and the movie starting about 15 minutes after sunset.
items.address: 2450 Heritage Park Row, San Diego, CA 92110
